result.reason: The added ownership clause reaches the preferred position: the Company retains its Content, Marks and customer-related data; HDI assigns the Site, deliverables and work product; HDI retains its pre-existing, generally applicable technology and grants the required perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence for embedded or necessary Vendor IP; and joint ownership is expressly disclaimed. The amendment is confined to the ownership gap, preserves the existing operational provisions and is professionally drafted.
